title: Oahu Island Full-Day Sightseeing Tour
requirements: Infants are required to sit on an adult’s lap
Not recommended for travelers with poor cardiovascular health
Suitable for all physical fitness levels
cancellation: For a full refund, cancel at least 24 hours before the scheduled departure time.
blurb: Ride along in our shuttle and discover some of the most beautiful places and major attractions on Oahu Island. You will explore the breathtaking nature of Oahu and the scenery and get a chance to enjoy Diamond Head Lookout, historic Haleiwa Town, and the world-renowned Dole Plantation gift shop (activities not included). Other attractions include Halona Blow Hole, East Coast, and North Shore. We will also pass/drive by other scenic beaches and the Kahala neighborhood. For lunch, we will stop by the food trucks in North Shore. ***Hotel Pick-up service is included from most of Waikiki Hotels
